segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: In the upper room, the night before the cross, Jesus told His disciples He was going to prepare a place for them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Thomas spoke up — Lord, we don't know where You're going, so how can we know the way?

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the way, the truth, and the life:

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The way itself. The truth itself. The life itself — standing right there in the room with them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The door to the Father isn't a map to find.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stop looking for the road. Walk with Him.
